name: TSM Spatial Runtime Fabric
purpose: Vendor-neutral contract for tiled basemaps, terrain, 3D assets, analytical overlays and deterministic spatial simulation.
designPrinciples: Use MapLibre-compatible style/tile contracts for 2D/2.5D mapping.
Use OGC 3D Tiles/glTF/GLB for large 3D assets and HLOD streaming.
Keep visualization transport separate from engineering authority and evidence.
Treat every layer as a versioned source with provenance, freshness, CRS and vertical datum metadata.
Use deterministic simulation orchestration; AI agents may propose actions but never mutate authoritative world state directly.
Prefer local/offline artifacts when the runtime is configured for sovereign/offline operation.
